theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_flat_decomposition
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), m + 1 < P → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j)) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → Bornology.IsBounded W → ⨆ j, ((Ts j).massOn W + (Ts j).boundary.massOn W) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → Bornology.IsBounded W → ∃ (R : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (S : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (R j) ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity (S j) ∧ T - Ts j - S j = (R j).boundary) ∧ Tendsto (fun j => (R j).massOn W + (S j).massOn W) atTop (𝓝 0)
